entries.en: Yongen-Jaya. This is Yongen-Jaya.
So this place is [clr 2]Yongen-Jaya[clr 27]...
The address I'm headed for[n]is still a little further...
I'll need to use the [clr 2]Ginza[clr 27][n][clr 2]Line[clr 27] to get to my school[n]in Aoyama-Itchome...
This is [clr 2]Aoyama-Itchome[clr 27]...
It took some time, but[n]I finally made it...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, I just remembered...!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Didn't you buy a cat bed? ...Even if it was[n]secondhand.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Eh, that's fine. Let's decide where to put it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What do you think of this amazing spot?[n]The dead center of the room!
No way.
Are you serious?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't worry, I'm just joking. It would get[n]in the way there, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Of course I am! Though... I guess it[n]would get in the way of your walking[n]through here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Then how about over here?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It has a great view of the room, and I[n]won't have to worry about the dust on[n]the floor either...
That won't work... Is this some kind of
joke?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No good? I thought it was a great spot...[n]Then again, you couldn't use the sofa[n]if we put it here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hahaha, of course it is! I mean, you[n]wouldn't be able to use the sofa if we[n]put it here, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm, this is tougher than I expected... I'm[n]positive this next idea will work, though.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, how about here!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It won't get in the way. Besides, I'm sure[n]you'd feel safer if I'm sleeping near you[n]too.
Sounds good.
I dunno...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, I totally think this is the best spot!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Too bad, it's already decided! This will[n]be the spot.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I finally have a place to call my own bed...[n]I don't have to sleep on top of you anymo—

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I-I mean, ha, hahaha! I've never done[n]anything like that!
